title: BARMM parliament to discuss 2027 budget, parliamentary rules on Nov. 24

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Bangsamoro Parliament will complete the proposed 2027 budget for the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) before the year ends, the parliament majority leader said Saturday, Nov. 21. Parliament Member Johari Abu, majority floor leader, said Speaker Amer Zaakaria Rakim issued a memorandum directing all parliament members to hold a regular session at 1 p.m. on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at the Shariff Kabunsuan Cultural Complex (SKCC) Plenary Session hall inside the Bangsamoro Government Center in Cotabato City. “Top priority is the proposed 2027 regional budget committee memberships,” Abu said.
